scope: Read-only CMake boundary review for Editor, AssetProcessor, launcher targets, and JEEditorFixture

observed_root.note: Root driver does not pass a LY_BUILD_TESTS knob; current engine CMake uses LY_DISABLE_TEST_MODULES.

configure_boundary.aztest: AZ::AzTest is created whenever GoogleTest support is true, independently of PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED; it has PUBLIC GMock, GTest, GoogleBenchmark, AzCore dependencies
configure_boundary.runner: AZ::AzTestRunner is created on supported platforms whenever GoogleTest support is true; source comments say it ships for users own tests; it links AZ::AzTest
configure_boundary.disable_modules: LY_DISABLE_TEST_MODULES defaults FALSE; when TRUE it makes PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED FALSE, but does not change PAL_TRAIT_TEST_GOOGLE_TEST_SUPPORTED

product_vs_test_targets.fixture: JEEditorFixture project.json is script_only=true. Its CMakeLists initializes O3DE but declares no C++ target. Engine cmake/Projects.cmake records LY_PROJECTS and sets LY_DEFAULT_PROJECT_PATH; Editor receives that path as startup argument. The fixture itself does not introduce AzTest/GTest.
product_vs_test_targets.editor: Editor, EditorCore, EditorLib do not list AZ::AzTest/GTest in production BUILD_DEPENDENCIES; Editor depends on AssetProcessor and runtime EditorLib/CrySystem. EditorCore.Tests and EditorLib.Tests are under PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED and privately link AZ::AzTest.
product_vs_test_targets.launcher: Launcher.Static/Headless/Unified/Server/Game have no AZ::AzTest in product dependencies; Launcher.Tests is guarded by PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED and privately links AZ::AzTest.
product_vs_test_targets.asset_processor: AssetProcessor.Static, AssetProcessor, AssetProcessorBatch.Static and AssetProcessorBatch have no AZ::AzTest/GTest in production BUILD_DEPENDENCIES; AssetProcessor.Tests is guarded by PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED and privately links AZ::AzTest.

test_runner_semantics.wrapper: ly_add_googletest registers test modules, adds AzTestRunner to build dependencies, uses it to invoke AzRunUnitTests, and declares AzTestRunner as runtime dependency for test registration

whitebox_csg.standalone_csg: Gems/WhiteBox/Code/Tests/CSG is a separate CMake project that builds the production WhiteBoxCsgCore.cpp and registers two native CTest cases; its CMakeLists uses no GTest/AzTest.
whitebox_csg.whitebox_gtest_targets: WhiteBox.Tests, WhiteBox.Editor.Tests and WhiteBox.Editor.Physics.Tests are under PAL_TRAIT_BUILD_TESTS_SUPPORTED; core test target links AZ::AzTest, editor variants use AzTestShared and editor/test framework deps.

minimum_separation.candidate: After a passing product baseline, if eliminating GoogleTest from the product-only engine configure remains necessary, introduce a deliberate build boundary separating AzTest/AzTestRunner/test modules from the product configure and keep a separate tests-enabled validation configuration. Existing source has no single observed LY_BUILD_TESTS knob providing that split.
minimum_separation.confirmed: Product app target declarations already exclude AzTest/GTest. LY_DISABLE_TEST_MODULES can remove engine test module targets, but does not remove the AZ::AzTest/AzTestRunner/GoogleTest configure path.
minimum_separation.tradeoff: Setting GoogleTest support false would suppress PAL test targets and AzTestRunner, including broad WhiteBox GoogleTest suites; the standalone CSG CTest project remains independently configurable. This is not a way to preserve all WhiteBox regressions.

search_note: Bounded searches excluded dependency, build, and asset trees; no general vendor inventory was run.
